note: City of Coffeyville's Walter Johnson Park, two loops of drive-through stalls on the east edge of town: The Woods (water and electric under big trees, dump station) and Rivercrest (open full-hookup grid against the Verdigris River levee). --Claude
summary: City pages (browser) confirm 118 FCFS sites: Woods 56 W/E $15 (15 at 50 A), Rivercrest 62 FHU $25 (53 at 50 A), weekly/monthly rates, open year round, dump. Fees 15/25 and electric 50 set; showers and laundry cleared (unsourced). Not waterfront stands. Split not recommended (~500 m apart).
flags: WATERFRONT: stored 'not waterfront' stands. Rivercrest (the open grid, centre ~37.0379,-95.5897) sits ~70-100 m from the Verdigris River, but behind the river levee (a raised embankment carrying a road between the grid and the channel), which blocks both the walk and the sightline, so no river value. The Woods (~37.0362,-95.5948) is ~600 m from the river among buildings and trees.

SPLIT: The Woods vs Rivercrest is NOT recommended. They have separate street addresses (701 Hargis / 600 Wood) and separate access streets per the city's directions, but the loop centroids are only ~510 m apart inside the same city park, under the ~1 km line. Per area, for the record: The Woods - 56 W/E spaces, 15 at 50 A (sites 2, 5, 9, 11, 16, 18, 20, 23, 24, 28, 31, 34, 45, 50, 55) and 41 at 30 A, $15/night, $90/week, dump station, angled drive-through stalls under trees, centre ~37.0362,-95.5948, not waterfront. Rivercrest - 62 full-hookup spaces, 53 at 50 A and 9 at 30 A (118, 142, 143, 145, 150-154), $25/night, $150/week, $600/month, open gravel drive-through grid, centre ~37.0379,-95.5897, behind the levee so not waterfront. Shower count unknown for both (city silent).
PIN 37.0369,-95.595 sits at the north edge of The Woods loop (~80 m from its centre); OK. Rivercrest is ~500 m ENE.
PHONE: none stored. The park line on the city page is 620-252-6106; City Clerk 620-252-6108; City Hall 620-252-6100 (also Google's number). Suggest 620-252-6106.
